message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to an API or tool that can retrieve SSL certificate histories. If you’re looking to investigate the certificate chain for a domain, you might consider using online services like SSL Labs’ Qualys SSL Test (https://www.ssllabs.com/ssltest/) or command‑line utilities such as `openssl s_client -connect reddit.com:443` followed by `openssl x509 -noout -text`. These will show you the current certificate chain and its validity period, but they won’t provide a historical record of past certificates.
